upgrade.elementals.mudSurge.description: Sends a wave of mud in the direction you're looking, slowing anyone caught in it.
upgrade.elementals.crystalShard.descript: Fires a spike of crystal in the direction you're looking, dealing damage to whatever it hits.
Release a cloud of gas around you, dazing and slowing every living thing caught inside.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasCloudS: Increases the radius of Gas Cloud by 0.75 blocks.
Increases the radius of Gas Cloud by another 0.75 blocks.
Reduces the cooldown of Gas Cloud by 1 second.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasVentII: Reduces the cooldown of Gas Cloud by another 1 second.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasSpecia: Choose a single path for your Gas Cloud: Suffocate, Leak, or Ignite. Only one can be active at a time.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasSuffoc: Your Gas Cloud instantly damages everyone caught inside it.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasLeak.d: Your Gas Cloud leaves a lingering cloud behind, slowing and dazing anyone who walks through it.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasLeakDu: Increases the duration of the lingering cloud by 5 seconds.
upgrade.elementalsmorebendings.gasIgnite: Ignites your Gas Cloud, causing an instant explosion centered on you. High risk, high reward.
